top_signals.title: Treasuries Rise as Recent Yield Surge Attracts Buyers Before Fed
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries rose as the US paused strikes on Iran and oil prices fell, with an auction of short-dated notes attracting buyers ahead of this week’s Federal Reserve meeting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: The certification could expand access to Tether’s gold-backed token among Islamic financial institutions and investors seeking Shariah-compliant exposure to physical gold.

top_signals.title: Peru: Keiko Fujimori Names Elmer Cuba as Peru Finance Minister
top_signals.summary: Consultant and former central bank director Elmer Cuba will lead Peruvian President-elect Keiko Fujimori’s economic agenda, a technocratic pick seen as signaling macroeconomic continuity in one of Latin America’s most stable economies.
